@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)
